components.name: Primary Header Action
components.description: The visible first-viewport route to security work.
components.css: .ds-header-action-primary { min-width: 184px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; color: #68e7ef; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #52cdd8; border-radius: 5px; font: 400 15px/1 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-header-action-primary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); background: rgba(88,212,224,0.06); } .ds-header-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header-action-primary:active { background: rgba(88,212,224,0.1); }

components.name: Secondary Header Action
components.description: A compact outlined route for GitHub and other secondary destinations.
components.css: .ds-header-action-secondary { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; color: #d9e0e1; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(126,171,179,0.72); border-radius: 5px; font: 400 15px/1 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-header-action-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); background: rgba(88,212,224,0.06); } .ds-header-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-header-action-secondary:active { background: rgba(88,212,224,0.1); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A quiet horizontal index whose current section is revealed in cyan.
components.html: WorkAboutContact
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; gap: 38px; color: #d9e0e1; font: 400 16px/1.2 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-primary-nav a:hover, .ds-primary-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); } .ds-primary-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary-nav a:active { color: #68e7ef; }

components.name: Evidence Node
components.description: A traceable unit in the analysis map, with orange reserved for the selected finding.
components.css: .ds-evidence-node { width: 148px; height: 46px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 13px; background: rgba(12,30,33,0.22); border: 1px solid rgba(104,174,184,0.72); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-evidence-node i { display: block; width: 72%; height: 2px; background: rgba(111,176,186,0.68); } .ds-evidence-node i:nth-child(2) { width: 52%; } .ds-evidence-node i:nth-child(3) { width: 63%; } .ds-evidence-node-active { border-color: var(--orange, #ff6a00); box-shadow: inset 0 0 16px rgba(255,106,0,0.05); } .ds-evidence-node-active i:first-child { background: rgba(240,134,64,0.7); } .ds-evidence-node:hover { border-color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); } .ds-evidence-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Rail
components.description: The four-step analysis sequence, with one orange segment carrying the active state.
components.css: .ds-evidence-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-width: 620px; padding: 36px 4%; border-top: 1px solid rgba(98,139,147,0.22); color: #cbd7d9; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(92,116,124,0.09), rgba(12,27,29,0.18)); font: 400 14px/1.2 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-evidence-rail i { position: relative; height: 1px; background: #4d7379; } .ds-evidence-rail i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; top: -2px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); } .ds-evidence-rail i.ds-active, .ds-evidence-rail i.ds-active::after { background: var(--orange, #ff6a00); } .ds-evidence-rail:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(92,116,124,0.13), rgba(12,27,29,0.22)); } .ds-evidence-rail:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-project-study { max-width: 560px; padding: 56px 0; color: #abb9bc; background: transparent; border-top: 1px solid rgba(98,139,147,0.3); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(98,139,147,0.3); font: 400 17px/1.55 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project-study h3 { margin: 0 0 28px; color: #eff2f3; font-size: clamp(34px,4vw,58px); line-height: 0.95; font-weight: 400; } .ds-project-study p { margin: 0; } .ds-project-study a { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 34px; padding-bottom: 6px; color: #dfe7e8; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(101,210,222,0.7); text-decoration: none; } .ds-project-study a:hover { color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); } .ds-project-study a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-project-study a:active { color: #68e7ef; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The understated repository and detail action used throughout project records.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 6px; color: #dfe7e8; background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(101,210,222,0.7); font: 400 16px/1.2 'Signika Negative', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); border-color: var(--cyan, #58d4e0); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #58d4e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-link:active { color: #68e7ef; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like software examined on a museum-conservation light table: a cool graphite field supports one dominant frosted evidence slab, and thin rules make claims feel traceable rather than ornamental. The central “Lâmina central” is the signature expression of this surface, not a requirement that every future page copy its composition.

The character is direct, technical, honest, curious, and understated. Evidence appears before adjectives; cyan reveals structure and interaction, while orange marks the one path or status that deserves attention. Material grain, translucency, and exact registration create refinement without “muito fru-fru.”
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite ground with frosted, translucent evidence surfaces.
Restrained cyan examination light and a single orange annotation voice.
Fine rules, registration geometry, and compact technical labels.
Clear field-of-study positioning with no inflated expertise claims.
Dense evidence on wide screens that becomes an orderly vertical sequence on mobile.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Cyan explains the examination system; orange identifies the exceptional active path. Do not use both as equal decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Contrast Rule
rules.body: Headings stay frosted and bright, supporting copy stays misted, and metadata recedes further so scanning order remains visible without extra ornament.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Stay within Signika Negative and create hierarchy through scale, weight, rhythm, and contrast; do not introduce a display face merely to make the portfolio feel more “designed.”

rules.name: The Honest Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking signals metadata or state, never a promotional eyebrow above every section.

rules.name: The Slab-Then-Sequence Rule
rules.body: Preserve one dominant evidence surface in the first viewport, then let subsequent sections read as ruled records rather than a wall of independent cards.

rules.name: The Tonal-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: Establish depth with translucency, overlap, texture, and ruled separation; do not add generic drop shadows to section containers.

rules.name: The Technical Corner Rule
rules.body: Keep controls between square and 5px; larger friendly-card rounding would break the light-table material language.

dos: Do lead with a concrete artifact, trace, project fact, or source relationship before applying evaluative language.
Do keep cyan structural and interactive, and reserve orange for one active finding, status, or path.
Do use fine rules, tonal washes, and translucency to group dense technical information.
Do preserve the explicit “field of study” positioning whenever mobile security and reverse engineering lead the page.
Do linearize evidence on narrow screens and remove connectors that would cross or obscure content.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a neon hacker terminal or a conventional split-hero portfolio.
Don't describe learning-stage work as expert authority, commercial proof, or unverified proficiency.
Don't add large radii, pill-heavy UI, glossy gradients, or generic floating-card shadows.
Don't use orange as a second general-purpose brand color; it is a scarce annotation.
Don't promote the hero’s exact plate coordinates or registration offsets into a universal layout recipe.
